answer: A willow web of trust admits newcomers only through opal seals, five held by each established agent. One seal admits a newcomer, two to bridge into a different cluster, and a seal regrows once per epoch, so one wallet cannot flood the network. Three rotating auditors sample 5% of fresh identities each epoch and check their work. A caught fake burns the voucher's $400 stake and voids the seal. Forging 100 clones needs 100 seals, $40,000 of stake at risk and at least 20 compromised vouchers, while one honest agent pays $0. Cheap clones snap like dry twigs; the willow web bends and holds.
